responsibility: Implements a small pretty-printer utility for rendering textual bar charts in analyzer dumps and statistics output. It stores labeled numeric items, computes display widths and scaling from the collected data, and emits aligned count-and-bar lines suitable for human-readable analyzer logging rather than analysis semantics.
same_name_distinction: Implements bar_chart behavior, including item accumulation, width/scale computation, and pretty-printer rendering of the textual chart. Unlike bar-chart.h, it contains the formatting algorithm rather than just the utility class definition.
